ticker_news.title: Nvidia's Big Number
ticker_news.description: Nvidia reported impressive $24 billion in free cash flow, but the company's small dividend payment continues to irk analyst Tim Beyers. The court ruling against Trump's tariffs also provided a 'relief rally' for the market, though the long-term impact remains uncertain.
ticker_news.author: Mary Long

ticker_news.title: 4 Semiconductor Stocks That Investors Should Not Ignore
ticker_news.description: The article discusses recent updates affecting Nvidia and other semiconductor stocks, including Advanced Micro Devices, Lam Research, Marvell Technology, ASML, Qualcomm, and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing.
ticker_news.author: Jose Najarro
